class.name: emcon_hardware_interface/EmconSystemInterface
class.description: EMCON hardware interface. Publishes joint commands to the Gazebo physics engine via gz-transport and reads joint state feedback back, completely bypassing ROS 2 DDS. Enables multi-domain EMCON operation where the controller_manager runs natively on the robot's ROS_DOMAIN_ID while Gazebo runs on a separate domain.
